opus.problem: Boarding a ship at Joppa for Tarshish is in Jonah 1:3, not in the cited verse. Jonah 1:2 only gives the command to go and preach against the city. Widen the reference to Jonah 1:2-3 or drop the Joppa and Tarshish detail.

The warning that the city would be overturned in forty days is in Jonah 3:4, not in the cited verse. Jonah 3:6 only covers the king leaving his throne and sitting in ashes. Widen the reference or drop the forty-day detail.

The cited verse does not name Nimrod, call him a mighty hunter, mention Shinar, or list Resen. Those details are in Genesis 10:8-12. Genesis 10:11 lists Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir and Calah. Widen the reference or reword the clue to match the verse.

The angel of the LORD striking down 185,000 Assyrians is in 2 Kings 19:35, not in the cited verse. 2 Kings 19:36 only says Sennacherib withdrew and returned to Nineveh. Widen the reference to 2 Kings 19:35-36 or drop the detail.
